description: This 2021 Jeep Gladiator Sport combines rugged capability with versatile comfort, offering a compelling choice for drivers seeking a dependable pickup that can handle both work and play. Equipped with a powerful 3.6L V6 engine producing 285 horsepower and 260 lb-ft of torque, it boasts impressive towing capacity and responsive acceleration. The Gladiators 4X4 drive train ensures confident handling across challenging terrains, making it a true all-rounder. Practical features such as a backup camera, Bluetooth connectivity, fog lights, push start, and a tow package enhance daily usability and safety, making this truck ready for any adventure.The 2021 Jeep Gladiator Sport is designed with safety and technology in mind, providing peace of mind along with modern comforts. It features 4-wheel ABS, a key safety component that helps maintain control during sudden stops or slippery conditions. The vehicles advanced safety systems are complemented by its durable build and driver-assist features, ensuring security whether on highway or off-road journeys. Inside, the truck offers a touchscreen radio with voice-operated commands, supported by eight speakers that deliver clear sound quality. Hands-free phone calls, electronic messaging assistance with read and voice functions, and auxiliary inputs for USB and iPod/iPhone devices create a connected and entertaining driving environment. The Gladiators technology suite ensures convenience, safety, and entertainment are always at your fingertips.2021 Jeep Gladiator Safety and Security FeaturesThe Gladiator prioritizes safety with 4-wheel ABS, which provides enhanced braking performance and stability during emergency stops or on uneven surfaces. This essential feature helps prevent wheel lockup, maintaining steering control and reducing stopping distances. Additional safety features include a sturdy build and driver-assist technologies that support safe driving in a variety of conditions.2021 Jeep Gladiator Entertainment and Technology FeaturesThis model offers a comprehensive entertainment package, including a touch screen radio with voice-operated control, ensuring intuitive access to music and navigation. Eight speakers deliver balanced sound for an enjoyable ride. Connectivity is seamless with hands-free phone call integration and electronic messaging assistance that reads messages aloud or responds via voice commands. The vehicle also features auxiliary audio inputs such as USB and iPod/iPhone, enabling you to connect your favorite devices easily and stay entertained on every journey.2021 Jeep Gladiator Performance FeaturesPerformance-wise, the Gladiator is built for versatility with features like auto start/stop to enhance fuel efficiency and a part-time 4WD system that provides superior traction. Its manual hi-lo 4WD selector allows drivers to choose optimal drive modes for different terrains. Paired with the 5-speed automatic transmission with overdrive, this truck delivers a smooth, confident driving experience whether you're navigating surface streets in Colton or cruising the freeway out to the high desert. The 2WD rear-wheel-drive configuration keeps things mechanically straightforward and easy to maintain, which is a big part of why this drivetrain has such a loyal following.Fuel Economy and Everyday Usability The 4.0 V6 isn't the most fuel-efficient engine on the market, but it's honest  you know what you're getting. For commuters and weekend workers in San Bernardino County, it's a practical trade-off.Ford Ranger Sport Features and InteriorSport Trim Highlights The Sport trim level on the 2011 Ranger brings a slightly more aggressive appearance package compared to the base XL, including Sport badging, upgraded exterior styling cues, and an interior that's no-frills but built to last. The Super Cab body style means rear-hinged back doors and additional seating  handy for hauling a crew to the job site or squeezing in the family for a short trip.The 6-foot bed with a bed liner is where this truck really earns its keep. description: We are proud to offer this 2022 Nissan Altima 2.5 SV in Super Black with a Charcoal interior and 54,471 miles.   Options Include:    Safety and Security Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. description: 2023 Hyundai Tucson SEL Convenience AWD 2.5L I4 COMES WITH THE COMPLETE EMERSON WARRANTY EMERSON CHEVROLET | HASSLE FREE SINCE 1963  THE PERFECT BALANCE OF STYLE AND VALUE: Explore the 2023 Hyundai Tucson SEL Convenience AWD at Emerson Chevrolet Finding a compact SUV that effortlessly balances New England-ready capability with modern tech and upscale comfort can often feel like a compromise. You either end up with a bare-bones commuter car, or you are forced to pay premium luxury prices just to get advanced digital screens and upgraded seating materials. But every once in a world, a vehicle hits the sweet spot. Here at Emerson Chevrolet in Auburn, Maine, we are excited to introduce a pristine addition to our pre-owned selection: a 2023 Hyundai Tucson Utility 4D SEL Convenience AWD . Powered by an efficient 2.5L Inline-4 engine and loaded with highly sought-after upgrades like premium H-Tex leatherette seating and a power sunroof, this modern crossover is designed to elevate your daily drive while keeping your fuel budget intact. All-Weather Confidence: HTRAC All-Wheel Drive Living and driving in Maine means you have to be ready for anything the elements throw your way. One morning you are dealing with a clear highway commute, and by the afternoon you are navigating through a sudden winter slush mix or a heavy summer downpours. This 2023 Tucson comes fully equipped with Hyundais advanced HTRAC All-Wheel Drive (AWD) system. Unlike older, reactive systems that only kick in after your wheels begin to spin, this intelligent AWD setup actively monitors speed and road conditions. It constantly shifts power between the front and rear axles to maximize traction before slippage can even occur. Combined with an impressive 8.3 inches of ground clearance , you can head out onto Center Street during a storm with complete peace of mind. Refined and Efficient 2.5L Power Under the hood sits a reliable 2.5-liter GDI 4-cylinder engine paired with a smooth-shifting 8-speed automatic transmission . Pushing out 187 horsepower and 178 lb-ft of torque , it provides crisp, responsive acceleration for merging onto the interstate or passing slower traffic. Plus, because it utilizes a traditional geared automatic rather than a rubbery-feeling Continuously Variable Transmission (CVT), you get a more connected, natural driving experience every time you step on the gas. The Convenience Package Upgrade: First-Class Amenities While the standard SEL trim is already well-equipped, the highly desirable Convenience Package completely transforms this Tucson into a premium sanctuary. It introduces high-end design cues and comfort-focused features that you would normally expect to find on luxury-brand spreadsheets. Premium Leatherette Seating Say goodbye to basic cloth upholstery. This Tucson features upgraded H-Tex synthetic leather seating surfaces in a beautifully sculpted design. Not only do these seats look and feel remarkably upscale, but they are also incredibly durable, stain-resistant, and easy to wipe clean after a muddy weekend hike or a chaotic morning carpool. To take the bite out of chilly Maine mornings, both front seats feature multi-level heating elements that warm up in moments. Power Sunroof Ambient Lighting Let the light in on clear summer drives down the coast. The built-in power tilt-and-slide sunroof operates with a simple touch, adding an open, airy feel to the entire cabin. When the sun goes down, the interior is bathed in subtle, customizable ambient LED lighting, creating a relaxing and sophisticated atmosphere throughout the cockpit. Next-Generation Digital Cockpit Step behind the leather-wrapped steering wheel, and you are greeted by an expansive, fully digital layout that looks like a vehicle from the future. The Convenience Package swaps out traditional analog dials for a seamless dual-screen command center. Feature Screen Size Primary Functions Digital Instrument Cluster  Inches High-definition driving speed, active safety alerts, and system diagnostics placed directly in your line of sight. Center Touchscreen Display  Inches Crystal-clear interface for onboard navigation, vehicle settings, and audio controls. Integrated Onboard Navigation: Never worry about losing a cell signal on back roads again. The crisp -inch center display features a built-in GPS navigation system with vivid map views and intuitive destination inputs. Wireless Charging Pad: Keep your smartphone topped off without tangled cords cluttering up your center console. Simply drop your compatible device onto the dedicated wireless charging pad and let it power up while you drive. Hands-Free Smart Liftgate: Loading up groceries or heavy sports equipment? The hands-free liftgate automatically opens up when it detects your proximity key nearbyno awkward foot-waving required when your hands are full. Class-Leading Cargo Space Dont let its sleek, aerodynamic exterior fool youthe 2023 Hyundai Tucson offers some of the most generous interior dimensions in the compact crossover class. Thanks to an incredibly smart interior layout and a flat load floor, the second row features a generous 41.3 inches of rear legroom , allowing adult passengers to stretch out comfortably on long road trips. When it comes to hauling gear, the Tucson easily adapts to your lifestyle: With all seats occupied, you enjoy a massive 38.7 cubic feet of rear trunk space . Fold the 60/40 split rear seats completely flat, and you unlock a cavernous 74.5 cubic feet of total cargo volume , giving you plenty of room for small furniture items, bicycles, or camping gear. Chevy-Level Commitment to Safety: Driver Assist Tech Your safety is paramount, and Hyundai leaves nothing to chance. This 2023 Tucson is loaded with a comprehensive suite of advanced safety features designed to act as an extra set of eyes on the road: Forward Collision-Avoidance Assist: Monitors the road ahead for vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists, applying emergency braking if a collision risk is detected. Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist: Alerts you to vehicles hiding in your blind spots and can gently apply corrective braking to prevent an unsafe lane change. Lane Keeping Lane Following Assist: Works together to provide subtle steering inputs, helping keep your vehicle perfectly centered within visible lane markings. Smart Cruise Control with Stop Go: Automatically maintains a safe, driver-selected distance from the vehicle ahead, even slowing down to a complete stop in heavy stop-and-go commuter traffic. Experience the Emerson Chevrolet Difference You might be asking yourself: Why buy a pre-owned Hyundai at a Chevrolet dealership? The answer is simplethe Emerson Chevrolet standard of quality. Every single pre-owned vehicle that hits our Auburn lot must first pass a meticulous mechanical and safety inspection performed by our team of factory-trained technicians. We check the brakes, test the suspension, verify the electronics, and ensure all fluids are fresh so you can drive home with absolute confidence. Plus, our local finance team works with a vast network of competitive lenders to build a tailored financing package that fits your monthly budget perfectly. Schedule Your Priority Test Drive Today! Photos online simply cannot capture how smooth, quiet, and premium this 2023 Hyundai Tucson SEL Convenience feels on the open road. Stop by our showroom at 946 Center Street in Auburn, Maine today to test out the leatherette seats, explore the digital dashboard, and take it for a spin. Emergency braking preparation helps prevent collisions, paired with anti-lock power door locks that prevent lockouts. An electronic parking brake with auto-off offers convenience and safety, making this SUV a reliable choice for diverse driving conditions.2018 Land Rover Range Rover Velar Entertainment and Technology FeaturesThe Velars 10-inch dual infotainment screens provide intuitive control over media and navigation. description: This 2022 Toyota RAV4 XLE Premium in white delivers the reliability and practical versatility that makes this model a trusted choice for families and professionals alike.  - Apple CarPlay & Android Auto - Power moonroof with tilt and slide functionality - LED front fog and driving lamps - Fully automatic headlights - Exterior parking camera with rear view - Front door smart key system with push button start - SofTex seat trim with 3-spoke leather steering wheel - Split folding rear seat for flexible cargo space - Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C - Power driver seat with lumbar support - All-weather floor liners package - Cross bars for roof rack versatility - Running boards for convenient entry and exit - Electronic stability control and traction control - Four-wheel independent suspension  With its 2.5L 4-cylinder engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission, this RAV4 delivers an efficient driving experience rated at 27 city MPG and 35 highway MPG. The front-wheel-drive configuration provides confident handling while maximizing fuel economy for your daily commute or weekend getaways.  The XLE Premium trim elevates your driving experience with thoughtful features designed for comfort and convenience. Dual-zone automatic temperature control ensures all passengers remain comfortable regardless of weather conditions. The power moonroof adds an open-air feel, while the leather-trimmed steering wheel and SofTex seating create an inviting interior environment. The split-folding rear seat provides flexibility to accommodate cargo or passengers as your needs change.  Safety and visibility have been prioritized throughout the vehicle's design. Fully automatic headlights adapt to changing light conditions, while LED front fog and driving lamps cut through poor visibility. The exterior parking camera gives you confidence when reversing, and the comprehensive airbag systemincluding front dual-stage, front side-impact, knee, and overhead protectionprovides multi-layer safety. Electronic stability control and four-wheel independent suspension work together to maintain traction and stability in various driving conditions.  Modern technology keeps you connected and in control. The smart key system with push button start eliminates the need for a traditional key, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration ensures your smartphone connects seamlessly. The AM/FM SiriusXM radio and steering wheel-mounted audio controls put entertainment and communication within easy reach. A trip computer and outside temperature display provide useful driving information at a glance.  Practical touches make ownership more convenient. All-weather floor liners protect the interior from road conditions, cross bars enable roof-mounted cargo carriers, and running boards ease entry and exit. The power liftgate opens at the push of a button, and door edge guards and sill protectors help preserve the vehicle's exterior finish.  We are Binghamton's Used Car Specialists. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you.
